content:
set -e
if [[ $SANITIZER = *undefined* ]]; then
  CFLAGS="$CFLAGS -fsanitize=unsigned-integer-overflow -fno-sanitize-recover=unsigned-integer-overflow"
  CXXFLAGS="$CXXFLAGS -fsanitize=unsigned-integer-overflow -fno-sanitize-recover=unsigned-integer-overflow"
fi
cd "$WORK"
mkdir build
cd build
cmake   -G"Unix Makefiles" -DBINARY_PACKAGE_BUILD=ON   -DWITH_PTHREADS=OFF -DWITH_OPENMP=OFF   -DWITH_PUGIXML=OFF -DUSE_XMLLINT=OFF -DWITH_JPEG=OFF -DWITH_ZLIB=OFF   -DBUILD_TESTING=OFF -DBUILD_TOOLS=OFF -DBUILD_BENCHMARKING=OFF   -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=FUZZ -DBUILD_FUZZERS=ON   -DLIB_FUZZING_ENGINE:FILEPATH="$LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE"   -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX:PATH="$OUT" -DCMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR:PATH="$OUT"   "$SRC/librawspeed/"
make -j$(nproc) all && make -j$(nproc) install
cd "$SRC"
rm -rf "$WORK/build"
./afl/Makefile
./afl/libdislocator/Makefile
./afl/libtokencap/Makefile
./afl/llvm_mode/Makefile
./honggfuzz/Makefile
./honggfuzz/examples/linux_kernel_ip/Makefile
./honggfuzz/examples/terminal-emulators/Makefile
./honggfuzz/socketfuzzer/Makefile
